summary: Restart seats with captured native context and optional incarnation fencing

replay.detail: No new replay trigger; accepted restart retries keep their original durable request and captured context.

schema.detail: Restart requests capture native session identity, path and fresh-context intent. POST /v1/agents/restart keeps incarnation_id optional. Native bindings use the existing /v1/agents/native-session endpoint with optional availability and idempotency fields, not a duplicate endpoint. No storage migration is added by these restart repairs.

rules.detail: The daemon enforces incarnation_id when supplied and refuses a mismatch. An empty id matches only a seat with no incarnation. Omission keeps existing callers working; the accepted request captures the current incarnation for reconciliation.

compatibility.detail: Existing callers may omit incarnation_id in the schema and CLI. Supplied stale or empty ids cannot restart a running incarnation. Typed actions apply the same optional fence semantics. Restart uses the existing native resume selector to preserve the saved conversation by default. fresh_context starts a new conversation and prevents later ordinary relaunches from reviving the old one before a new binding is reported.

downtime.detail: Normal binary deployment; interruption timing has not been measured.

manual.detail: Correct an unidentified runtime before retrying a refused fenced restart. The CLI promptly reports a replacement's blocked channel so attachment can be corrected while mail stays held.

recovery.detail: No new data conversion; restart attempts and completion receipts remain durable and idempotent.
